C-16.Name: Agent-output paste hygiene: smart paste + clipboard image paste (matrix P0-C/P0-D)
C-16.Summary: Two small paste-pipeline gaps from docs/research/markdown-feature-matrix.md P0 list. P0-D smart paste: pasting a URL over a selection wraps it as [text](url); pasting rich HTML converts it to markdown via the already bundled turndown + joplin-turndown-plugin-gfm (deps verified in package.json). P0-C clipboard image paste: restoring the v1 ability to paste a screenshot bitmap from the clipboard into the document as a local file + relative link — today only file-path clipboard entries work (guessClipboardFilePath reads NSFilenamesPboardType/FileNameW); bitmap data needs a backend NSPasteboard image reader via core-foundation (same raw-sys lane as C-15 bookmarks).

Problem.Description: Agents and users paste URLs, rich HTML, and screenshots into Mark. Today: a URL paste over a selection discards the selection; rich HTML pastes as flattened text or noisy markup; a screenshot bitmap pastes as nothing (only Finder-copied file paths are handled by muya's clipboardFilePath option).
Problem.RootCause: src/muya/lib/contentState/pasteCtrl.js handles plain text, markdown text, and clipboardFilePath images, but has no URL-on-selection branch and no HTML branch; the Tauri port has no clipboard image bitmap reader at all (v1 Electron read NSPasteboard image data in the main process; that code was not ported).

Goals.R-1: P0-D URL smart paste: when the clipboard holds a bare http(s) URL — including the bare-host form ("https://github.com") that URL_REG's mandatory /path rejects — and the editor has a non-empty single-block selection, paste replaces the selection with [selected text](url); brackets in the selection are escaped so they cannot break the link syntax. mailto: stays out of scope (SMART_PASTE_URL_REG is http(s) only). Cursor lands after the link. With an empty selection, behavior is unchanged (plain URL text).
Goals.R-2: P0-D HTML paste (amended): pin and harden the EXISTING html2State paste path — adversarial fixtures prove script/style/on* attributes never survive standardizeHTML's DOMPurify pass, and rich fixtures (headings/bold/links/lists/tables) convert to the expected markdown blocks. The working path is not replaced — its existing internal html2State→turndown conversion keeps doing the work; no NEW turndown step is added.
Goals.R-3: P0-C bitmap paste (amended): pin the EXISTING pipeline — pasteImage's clipboardData.items branch (File → base64 preview → imageAction → move-to-folder/relative src) — with unit + Chromium e2e coverage (synthetic clipboard File), plus one live-app smoke proving a real screenshot paste lands as a local file + link in WKWebView. The Rust NSPasteboard reader is a deferred non-goal unless the smoke fails.
Goals.R-4: No regression to the three existing paste behaviors: plain text, markdown source paste (multi-line block handling), and Finder file-path image paste — pinned by new unit tests plus existing coverage.

Constraints.Constraint: No new npm runtime dependencies (turndown/dompurify already bundled). Rust side may use core-foundation only (already a dependency for C-15).
All clipboard reads happen on explicit user paste (Cmd+V / context menu Paste) — no background clipboard polling.
Sanitization before turndown (DOMPurify) — clipboard HTML is untrusted input; no script/style/event-handler survival.
Scoped 100% line+branch coverage of changed pasteCtrl/clipboard code paths; e2e visual gates for URL-paste and image-paste happy paths via the tauri-shim (clipboard mocked); grace lint zero findings.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Clipboard history UI, paste-preview popups, or paste-and-match-style menu plumbing beyond reusing existing entries.
Linux/Windows clipboard image backends (macOS-only product phase).
Image editing/compression of pasted bitmaps (existing imageAction behavior applies as-is).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit: URL-on-selection → [text](url); URL with empty selection → plain text; HTML → sanitized markdown via turndown; plain/markdown paste paths unchanged.

Unit + e2e: pasteImage items branch converts a synthetic clipboard File into an image block with a local relative src (imageAction path exercised); WKWebView smoke evidence recorded in the plan Evidence section.

E2e (Playwright + tauri-shim): pasting HTML produces the markdown equivalent and hostile HTML yields no live markup; URL-over-selection and image paste are unit-pinned (muya cursor model is not synthetic-event-drivable) plus WKWebView live-app smoke checklist entries.
Full suite green; two sequential reviews (correctness/races, security/contracts — clipboard HTML is untrusted input) both clean.
